description: This file defines a React functional component 'CartPage' that displays the user's shopping cart, allowing updating item quantities, removing items, clearing the cart, and proceeding to checkout. It utilizes context hooks for cart and auth state management and react-router for navigation.

methods.name: CartPage()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the shopping cart page, handling checkout and cart item management.

methods.name: onCheckout
methods.description: Async function to handle the checkout process, including navigating to login if not authenticated, or to order details page after checkout.
